words.definition: to give up a throne, power or duty
words.sentence: The old king chose to abdicate in favor of his daughter.

words.definition: to officially end a law or agreement

words.definition: hard to understand because it is complex or obscure
words.sentence: The professor's abstruse lecture left everyone confused.

words.definition: a short, well-known saying that expresses a truth
words.sentence: The old adage says that practice makes perfect.

words.definition: to calm a fear or worry

words.definition: a strong feeling of dislike

words.definition: widely told but probably not true
words.sentence: The story about the coach's lucky socks is apocryphal.

words.definition: to calm someone by giving them what they want
words.sentence: They offered a snack to appease the cranky toddler.

words.definition: full of strong feeling or enthusiasm

words.definition: clever tricks used to fool people

words.definition: showing signs that the future will be good

words.definition: a scene of noisy confusion

words.definition: to give a false idea of something

words.definition: eager to fight or start a war

words.definition: to grow or spread quickly

words.definition: a feeling of worry and confusion

words.definition: harm or damage

words.definition: to slowly disappear or scatter

words.definition: able to make mistakes

words.definition: a small weakness or odd habit

words.definition: to gather or collect, especially support or praise

words.definition: a pause or break

words.definition: to drive or push someone to act

words.definition: the start of something

words.definition: impossible to remove or forget

words.definition: harmless and not likely to upset anyone

words.definition: a particular point in time or in a series of events

words.definition: humor at a serious moment

words.definition: talking a lot

words.definition: clear and easy to understand

words.definition: easily shaped or changed

words.definition: not telling the truth

words.definition: a small amount

words.definition: a very large number of things

words.definition: just beginning to develop

words.definition: a person who is new to something

words.definition: to remove a need or problem before it happens

words.definition: a typical example or model of something

words.definition: the state of having too little of something

words.definition: again and again over a long time

words.definition: to spread through every part of something

words.definition: an amount that is more than enough

words.definition: a strong liking for something

words.definition: a natural tendency to behave a certain way

words.definition: ordinary and lacking imagination

words.definition: quick to argue or fight

words.definition: a difficult situation that is hard to escape

words.definition: to publicly take back something you said or believed

words.definition: to move someone or something to a lower position

words.definition: most noticeable or important

words.definition: very weak or slight

words.definition: without knowing or meaning to
